answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. I cleared the digger and the dead knight at Eurydike and found Unbound bottles of grey seal, a paralysis poison used to numb a tree scar shut after they drain it. 2. Open the knight-captain tomb door with the keystone and search the chest inside. 3. Use the keystone on the door; the lock may also be pickable. I could also keep the poison. 4. I do not understand why the Unbound drain and then seal trees, or what the Root and the Eye are. I might learn from the tomb contents or from Nesh-Deeka.

answer 1. I opened the knight-captain tomb with the keystone and took a bronze disc stamped with a pick crossed with a tower, a mine mark. It is what marked the kings road to the Root, I think. 2. Bring the disc to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Go straight to her, or keep the disc and look into the mark first; I also have gold and the other items. 4. I do not know which mine the mark belongs to, nor what the Root and Eye really are. Nesh-Deeka may tell me.

answer Notes: I work for Nesh-Deeka (Toh-Reel-Ka, Helstrom). I opened the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike with the Kothringi Keystone, killed the Unbound digger and the restless knight, took 3 Grey Seal paralysis poisons from the Unbound pack (the Unbound drain trees then numb the scar shut with it, and I do not know why), and took the bronze disc. I gave it to Nesh-Deeka. The mark, a pick and tower, is Vicrium, an old ochre and alum mine in the clay country behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei in the east; the knights kept a strongbox there. This is a step to the Eye of Argonia at the Root. She was paid me 100 gold again, so I have about 800. She knew the Unbound were at Eurydike and only said "we listen"; how she knows stays unanswered. I still carry the Pale Harvest strongbox key, Old Silver Setting, The Collector note, smuggler key. Next: go to Vicrium near Seafalls before the Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin). Unknown: what the Root and the Eye really are, why trees are sealed, how Nesh-Deeka knows things.
